snippet.title: Zaalima - Lyrical | Raees | Shah Rukh Khan | Arijit Singh & Harshdeep K | JAM8-Pritam
snippet.description:
Song - Zaalima
Music - JAM8
Lyrics - Amitabh Bhattacharya
Singers - Arijit Singh and Harshdeep Kaur
Choreography - Bosco- Caesar

Written by - Rahul Dholakia, Harit Mehta, Ashish Vashi & Niraj Shukla
Director Of Photography - K.U Mohanan ISC
Produced By - Ritesh Sidhwani, Gauri Khan & Farhan Akhtar
Directed By - Rahul Dholakia

Sound Design:- Dj Phukan, Sunny M.R.
Programmers:- Sourav Roy, Dj Phukan, Sunny M.R., Rohan Chauhan, Arijit Singh
Mix & Master:- Shadab Rayeen @ Newedge
Assistant:- Abhishek Sortey
Shoot Mix:- Ashwin Kulkarni
Recording Engineers:- Ashwin Kulkarni, Himanshu Shirlekar, Aaroh Velankar, Kaushik Das
Vocal Conductor:- Akashdeep Sengupta, Kaushik Das, Tushar Joshi

Musicians:-
Drums:- Alan Hertz
Bass:- Ernest Tibbs
Duff:- Iqbal Azad
Harmonium:- Feroz Shaikh
Acoustic Guitars:- Pawan Rasaily and Arijit Singh
Electric Guitars:- Pawan Rasaily 

Lyrics:
Jo Teri Khatir Tadpe Pehle Se Hi
Kya Usey Tadpana O Zaalima, O Zaalima
Jo Tere Ishq Mein Behka Pehle Se Hi
Kya Usey Behkana O Zaalima, O Zaalima

Aankhen Marhaba, Baatein Marhaba
Main Sau Martaba Deewana Huaa
Mera Na Raha Jab Se Dil Mera
Tere Husn Ka Nishana Hua

Jiski Har Dhadkan Tu Ho
Aise Dil Ko Kya Dhadkana
O Zaalima, O Zaalima

Saanson Mein Teri Nazdeeqiyon Ka
Itrr Tu Ghol De, Ghol De…
Main Hi Kyun Ishq Zaahir Karun
Tu Bhi Kabhi Bol De, Bol De…

Leke Jaan Hi Jaayega Meri
Qaatil Har Tera Bahaana Hua
Tujhse Hi Shuru
Tujhpe Hi Khatam
Mere Pyaar Ka Fasaana Hua

Tu Shamma Hai Toh Yaad Rakhna
Main Bhi Hoon Parwaana
O Zaalima, O Zaalima..

Deedaar Tera Milne Ke Baad Hi
Chhoote Meri Angdaayi
Tu Hi Bata De Kyun Zaalima Main Kehlayi..

snippet.title: Sunil Giri x Melina Rai • A Ho Maya • Sagar Sunar • Ganesh Man Ghale • Krishala Tamang
snippet.description:
A heartfelt song about everlasting love, deep devotion, and the promise to stay together through every joy and sorrow. It tells the story of two hearts that choose each other through life’s ups and downs, holding on to their love until the very end.
Composed by Sagar Sunar and written by Sunil Giri, the song comes to life through the beautiful voices of Melina Rai and Sunil Giri. Featuring Ganesh Man Ghale and Krishala Tamang, the music video captures this love story against the beautiful landscapes of Pokhara, Nepal.
Heartfelt thanks to everyone who helped bring this song to life.

snippet.title: YOUNG LAMA X VTEN - BIG 24 ( OFFICIAL VIDEO )
snippet.description:
🇳🇵 NEPAL 🇺🇸 USA | TWO COUNTRIES. TWO CITIES. ONE SOUND. 🌍🔥
From the streets of Kathmandu to New York and Boston, two incredibly versatile artists, VTEN & YOUNG LAMA, comes together for their third collaboration, bringing their unique sounds, energy, and creativity across borders.
A collaboration connecting Kathmandu's Nepali hip-hop scene to the Nepali diaspora in the United States.
This music video is a joint visual production between RIOTCOBAIN (NEPAL), SHAN FILMS (Nepal) and NEWCHI PRODUCTIONS (USA), bringing together creative teams working thousands of miles apart with one shared vision.


🎬 MUSIC VIDEO CREDITS
🎤 Performed by: VTEN & YOUNG LAMA
🎧 Mix & Master: @riotcobain

Filmed  by: Ghishing21 ( https://www.instagram.com/ghising21/ )
https://www.youtube.com/@UCEi_nTVym-70MoiTVSDR5Pg 

🇺🇸 USA - NEWCHI PRODUCTIONS
    •    Cinematography: Milan Thapa
    •    Production Manager: Mamta Ale
    •    Asst: Rulesh Maharjan
    •    Production: Newchi Productions

🙏 BIG 24s & SPECIAL THANKS
TEAM FOMO | MAYBE MARS STUDIO CAFE | SHAN FILMS | MILAN THAPA | NEWCHI PRODUCTIONS | TRAP NEPAL l ARO SONAM l LAWL3SS ASIAN

This collaboration is more than just music. It connects artists, filmmakers, and creative communities across continents while representing Nepali hip-hop on a global stage.

snippet.title: Anuv Jain - Arz Kiya Hai (Official Lyrical Video) | Romantic Song
snippet.description:
Some feelings are too beautiful to be put into words and some stories are best told through a song. ❤️

Presenting Arz Kiya Hai by Anuv Jain a heartfelt musical journey that captures the beauty of unspoken emotions, the magic of love and everything that remains unsaid.

With his signature soulful voice and deeply moving melodies, Anuv takes you through a world where every word feels personal, every note touches the heart and every emotion finds its way home.

Because sometimes, all the heart wants to do is make one simple arz… ✨

Listen. Feel. Fall in love.

Lyrics : 

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1]
Kaayar jo the, woh shaayar bane
Ab kya-kya karein yeh ishq mein
Na kehte the kuch jo, lage khoj mein
Kya lafz chune, naye aashiq yeh

[Pre-Chorus]
Ishq mein tere hain Faiz bane
Arz kiya hai
Humne bhi likha kuch tere baare mein hai

[Chorus]
Aise tu lage ki gulaab hai
Aur aise tu lage ki gulaab hai
Baaghon mein dil ke khilke inn fizaaon mein chhaye ho, haaye
Aur waise hum toh tere hi ghulaam hain
Aur waise hum toh tere hi ghulaam hain
Baadshah dil ke, teri baazi mein jo tu chaahe toh

[Verse 2]
Doobе dilo ki kya naav banoon?
Main khud tair paaoon na aankhon mein
Shaayar ki fitrat mein hi doobna
Main kya hi ladoon toofano se

[Pre-Chorus]
Ishq mеin tere hain Faiz bane
Arz kiya hai
Humne bhi likha kuch tere baare mein hai

[Chorus]
Haathon ko sambhale mere haathon mein
Kaise haathon ko sambhale mere haathon mein
Jab tak neend na aaye, inn lakeeron mein baatein ho, haaye

[Sargam]
Sa-re-pa-ga-re-sa, re-ga-pa-ga, pa-ni, pa-ni
Sa-re-pa-ni, pa-ga, pa-ma, ga-ma, ga-re, ga-re, sa-ni-sa
Sa-re-sa-ni-pa-ni, sa-ga-re, re-ga-pa-ni-sa-ga
Ga-re-sa-re-sa-ni, ma-dha-pa
Pa-ni-sa-ni-pa-ni, pa-ga-pa-re-re-sa
Re-ga, re-ga, ma-dha, pa-ni, pa-ni, sa-ni-dha
Sa-ni, sa-ni, pa-dha, pa-ma, ga-ma-ga

[Bridge]
Haan, sab ne toh sab keh diya hai
Kya hi kahoon jo abhi bhi ankaha hai
Main, haaye, na Mirza, na Mir
Na maahir, na zaahir karoon kuch naya main
Haaye, par jo bhi likha hai, jiya hai
Haan, jiya hai
Aise, aise, aise kaise? Waise jaise

[Chorus]
Jaise main padhoon mere dil mein jo
Meri aankhein bhi padhe teri aankhon ko
Kya yeh mehfil mein baithein ya uthein daud jaane ko? Haaye
Teri aankhon mein taareefon ki talaash hai
Meri mehfil tere jaane se veeraan hai
Main bas shaayar bana hoon sirf tu sun'ne aaye toh

[Outro]
Shaayad shaayar bana hoon
Sirf tu sun'ne aaye toh

Hindi Lyrics : 

कायर जो थे, वो शायर बने
अब क्या-क्या करें ये इश्क़ में
ना कहते थे कुछ जो, लगे खोज में
क्या लफ़्ज़ चुने, नए आशिक़ ये

इश्क़ में तेरे हैं फ़ैज़ बने
अर्ज़ किया है
हमने भी लिखा कुछ तेरे बारे में है

ऐसे तू लगे कि ग़ुलाब है
और ऐसे तू लगे कि ग़ुलाब है
बागों में दिल के खिलके इन फ़िज़ाओं में छाए हो, हाय
और वैसे हम तो तेरे ही ग़ुलाम हैं
और वैसे हम तो तेरे ही ग़ुलाम हैं
बादशाह दिल के तेरी बाज़ी में जो तू चाहे तो

डूबे दिलों की क्या नाव बनूँ?
मैं ख़ुद तैर पाऊँ ना आँखों में
शायर की फ़ितरत में ही डूबना
मैं क्या ही लड़ूँ तूफ़ानों से

इश्क़ में तेरे हैं फ़ैज़ बने
अर्ज़ किया है
हमने भी लिखा कुछ तेरे बारे में है

हाथों को संभालें मेरे हाथों में
कैसे हाथों को संभालें मेरे हाथों में
जब तक नींद ना आए, इन लकीरों में बातें हो, हाय

हाँ, सब ने तो सब कह दिया है
क्या ही कहूँ जो अभी भी अनकहा है
मैं, हाय, ना मिर्ज़ा, ना मीर, ना माहिर, ना ज़ाहिर
करूँ कुछ नया मैं
हाय, पर जो भी लिखा है, जिया है
हाँ, जिया है
ऐसे, ऐसे, ऐसे, कैसे, वैसे, जैसे

जैसे मैं पढ़ूँ मेरे दिल में जो
मेरी आँखें भी पढ़ें तेरी आँखों को
क्या यह महफ़िल में बैठें या उठें
दौड़ जाने को? हाय
तेरी आँखों में तारीफ़ों की तलाश है
मेरी महफ़िल तेरे जाने से वीरान है
मैं बस शायर बना हूँ
सिर्फ़ तू सुनने आए तो
शायद शायर बना हूँ सिर्फ़ तू सुनने आए तो

en-US.description:
Some feelings are too beautiful to be put into words and some stories are best told through a song. ❤️

Presenting Arz Kiya Hai by Anuv Jain a heartfelt musical journey that captures the beauty of unspoken emotions, the magic of love and everything that remains unsaid.

With his signature soulful voice and deeply moving melodies, Anuv takes you through a world where every word feels personal, every note touches the heart and every emotion finds its way home.

Because sometimes, all the heart wants to do is make one simple request…

Listen. Feel. Fall in love.

Lyrics:

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1]
The singers became poets.
Now what should I do in this love?
Those who didn't say anything are searching.
What words should I choose, these new lovers.

[Pre-Chorus]
In love, you have become Faiz.
I have requested that I too have written something about you.

[Chorus]
You felt like a rose,
And you felt like a rose,
The flowers of the heart are blooming in the gardens, oh my God.
And in fact, I am your slave.
And in fact, I am your slave. Yes, King of hearts, I can do whatever you want in your game.

[Verse 2]
What boat should I build for the broken hearts? I myself am not thirsty, nor am I drowned in the rain in my eyes.
It is the poet's nature to drown myself in the storms.

[Pre-Chorus]
In love with you, I have become a blessing.

I have submitted that I have also written something about you.

[Chorus]
Hold the hands in my hands.
How do you hold the hands in my hands?
Until sleep comes, let's talk in these lakes, oh my god.

[Sargam]
Sa-re-pa-ga-re-sa, re-ga-pa-ga, pa-ni, pa-ni
Sa-re-pa-ni, pa-ga, pa-ma, ga-ma, ga-re, ga-re, Sa-ni-sa
Sa-re-sa-ni-pa-ni, sa-ga-re, re-ga-pa-ni-sa-ga
Ga-re-sa-re-sa-ni, ma-dha-pa
Pa-ni-sa-ni-pa-ni, pa-ga-pa-re-re-sa
Re-ga, re-ga, ma-dha, pa-ni, pa-ni, sa-ni-dha
Sa-ni, sa-ni, pa-dha, pa-ma, ga-ma-ga

[Bridge]
Yes, everyone has said it all.
What should I say about what is still unsaid?
I, yes, am not Mirza, nor Mir.
I am not Mahir, nor should I reveal anything new.
Yes, but whatever I have written, I have lived it.
Yes, I have lived it.
Like this, like this How? Just like

[Chorus]
Like I read what is in my heart
So that my eyes also read your eyes
Did he sit in the gathering or did he get up to run? Hey!
Your eyes are searching for praise.
My gathering is saddened by your departure.
I have become a poet, just because you came to hear me.

[Outro]
Maybe I have become a poet, just because you came to hear me.

Hindi Lyrics:

Those who were cowards have become poets.
Now what can they do in love?
They used to say nothing, but are now searching.
What words can these new lovers choose?

In your love, I have become Faiz.
I have said,
I have also written something about you.

You look like a rose.
And you look like a rose.
You bloom in the gardens of my heart and fill the air.
Alas, I am your slave.
And I am your slave.
Your king of my heart. If you want, in a game,

Should I become a boat for drowning hearts?

If I can't swim in your eyes myself,

It's in a poet's nature to drown.

Why should I fight the storms?

In your love, I have become Faiz.

I have said something about you too.

Let my hands be held in my hands.

How can I hold my hands in my hands?

Until sleep comes, let these lines speak, alas.

Yes, everyone has said everything.
What can I say about what is still unsaid?
I, alas, am neither Mirza, nor Mir, nor Mahir, nor shall I reveal anything new.
Alas, but whatever I have written, I have lived it.
Yes, I have lived it.
This way, this way, this way, how, that way, as I may.

Whatever I read in my heart,
My eyes too read your eyes.
Should I sit in this gathering or should I get up
to run? Alas,
Your eyes are searching for praise.
My gathering is desolate with your departure.
I have become a poet only if you come to listen.
Perhaps I have become a poet only if you come to listen.

snippet.title: Sundari | Nishant Mukta | I-Popstar Hindi Vol.2 | EP 16 | Alright TV | Netflix
snippet.description:
I-Popstar Hindi Vol. 2 is streaming on Alright TV app and Netflix

New Episodes Every Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday on Alright TV app at 08:00 PM! Watch Now: https://alrighttv.go.link/9AuBt

New Episodes Every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday on Netflix at 08:00 PM! Watch Now: https://www.netflix.com/search?q=i-popstar&jbv=83190432

👉 Subscribe to Saregama Music: https://bit.ly/3FkAS0W

Credits:

Singer: Nishant Mukta
Composer: Nishant Mukta
Lyrics: Nishant Mukta
Music Director: Shamir Tandon
Music Supervisor: Ahan Shah
Lyrics Supervisor: Pinky Poonawala
Arranged and programmed by: Muheet Bharti
Mixed and Mastered by - Sachin Nair at Sonic Jungle Studios
Dolby Atmos : Team CFP
Head Mix Engineer - Nikhil Mathew
Assisted by - Abhishek Poojary, Gayatri Karekar, Subhashree Das
Mixes supervised by Sunny M.R. for Chordfather Productions
Project manager at CFP : Rashi Chauhan
CF Energizers : Arun, Ajay, Izzy
Vocal Coaches: Bhavya Pandit & Divya S Iyer
Music Operations Head : Tannishtha Puri & Anany Kakade
Audio Post Production: Gopal Thakare, Jay Tiwari, Hridoy Chandan
Tech Supervision: Madhur Hatiskar

Lyrics:

INTRO
Dekhat rahe hamke u jhaki ke khidki se
Voh khidki se jhaank kar mujhe dekh rahi thi

Pyar bhail fir laika ke Bengali ladki se
Phir us ladke ko Bengali ladki se pyaar ho gaya

Paas bula ke hamra upar jaadu kai dehlas
Paas bulaakar usne mujh par jaadu kar diya

Dil dhadke Nishant ke ab toh okre marzi se
Ab Nishant ka dil usi ki marzi se dhadakta hai

PRE-HOOK
Hamke fasailas apna baat mein
Usne mujhe apni baaton mein fansa liya

HOOK
Sundari hamra ke chede aadha raat mein
Sundari aadhi raat ko mujhe chhedti hai

Bijuriya hamke fasailas apna baat mein
Bijuriya ne mujhe apni baaton mein fansa liya

Sundari hamra ke chede aadha raat mein
Sundari aadhi raat ko mujhe chhedti hai

U laiki hamke fasailas apna baat mein
Uss ladki ne mujhe apni baaton mein fansa liya

VERSE 1
Ek din le gaini okra bazari mein
Ek din main use bazaar le gaya

Hot lage uu laal colour ke saree mein
Vah laal rang ki saari mein bahut hot lag rahi thi

Ghumat rahni okra sanghe gaadi mein
Main uske saath gaadi mein ghoom raha tha

Kiss bhail fir pehla pehla bari mein
Phir pehli baar mein hi kiss ho gaya

Phir hamahu ta sharma gaini
Phir main bhi sharma gaya

Aur uu bhi hase lagal
Aur voh bhi hasne lagi

Chakkar mein Nishantwa okar
Nishant uske chakkar mein

Pura fase lagal
Poori tarah fansne laga

RAP
Fir kar deni gadi ke ham side
Phir maine gaadi side mein laga di

Black dress hamar baal rahe white
Kaali dress thi aur baal safed the

Raat 12 baje scene rahe tight
Raat ke 12 baje mahaul bilkul tight tha

Fir boldeni banbu ka wife
Phir maine bol diya ki kya tum meri patni banogi?

Tora khush rakhab etna ki koi na rakhi
Tujhe itna khush rakhunga jitna koi nahin rakhega

Tora niyan dekhni ham koi na kabhi
Tere jaisi maine kabhi kisi ko nahin dekha

Kah dem bat aisan koi na kahi
Aisi baat kahunga jo koi nahin kahega


Saath mein Nishantwa ta koi na sati
Aur Nishant jitna koi saath nahin nibhayega


VERSE 2
Ham tohre chahila
Main tumhein hi chahta hoon

Tohre ke manila
Tumhein hi maanta hoon

Tu he badu munni hamar
Tum hi meri Munni ho

Tu he badu Shila
Tum hi meri Shila ho

PRE - HOOK (BRIDGE)
Na tora pahile na koi baad mein
Na tumse pehle koi, na tumhare baad koi

OUTRO
Sundari hamra ke chede aadha raat mein
Sundari aadhi raat ko mujhe chhedti hai

Bijuriya hamke fasailas apna baat mein
Bijuriya ne mujhe apni baaton mein fansa liya

Sundari hamra ke chede aadha raat mein
Sundari aadhi raat ko mujhe chhedti hai

Uu laiki hamke fasailas apna baat mein
Uss ladki ne mujhe apni baaton mein fansa liya

snippet.description:
Junglee Music presents 'Parvati (Jab Zid Pe Aa Gayi Parvati)', a powerful Shiva-Parvati devotional song by Sadhu Tiwari from the film Hanuman Ansh. Dedicated to Goddess Parvati and Lord Shiva, this new Hindi bhakti song celebrates the divine bond of Shiv and Parvati, reflecting the strength, determination, and devotion of Maa Parvati. With expressive vocals and captivating music, 'Parvati' brings alive the spiritual essence of Shiv Shakti and the timeless connection between Mahadev and Mata Parvati.

Sadhu Tiwari's heartfelt rendition makes 'Jab Zid Pe Aa Gayi Parvati' a beautiful addition to your Shiva Parvati songs, Shiv bhajan, and Hindi devotional music playlists. Listen to this soulful song from Hanuman Ansh and experience the divine energy of Shiv Shakti. Watch the full video, celebrate the devotion of Maa Parvati, and share this beautiful bhakti song with your loved ones.

snippet.title: Dj Wale Babu Mera Gana Chala Do - 8K/4K Music Video | Badshah | Aastha Gill | Natasha
snippet.description:
From Badshah and Aastha Gill’s iconic party anthem “DJ Wale Babu,” featuring Natasha Stankovic, get ready to groove to the ultimate party banger!

#Badshah #DJWaleyBabu #aasthagill #partysongs #popsongs #ipop 

Artist - Badshah & Aastha Gill
Music / Lyrics - Badshah
Album - ONE (Original Never Ends)
Video - Director Gifty
Choreography - Vamika Lamba
Brand Partner - BBT
Label - Sony Music India

Lyrics 
Now Sing Along 
DJ wale babu mera gaana chala do
Gaana chala do..

Dj wale babu mera gaana tu chala de
Thodi volume unchi de
Thoda bass tu bada de..

Arrey club mein teri sarkar banadun
Table ko teri bar banadun
Waise to hoon Badshah
Main aaj raat tujhe star bana du
Aissa baby kaam kara du
Dance floor tere naam kara du

Ghur ke dekhe jo koi tujh ko
Kaan pe uske char lagga du
Jee bhar ke naach le baby
Champagne ke shower mein
Yaar tere ka fan manister
Baitha hai joh power mein

Dj waley mera gaana tu chala de
Thodi volume unchi de
Thoda bass tu bada de..

Duniya rakhon jhuton ke niche
Tu kahe to bann jaun DJ
Din raat bajao yun gaane
Hindi English naye purane
Hukum chala request na kar
Nachi ja baby rest na kar

Patient hoon tere husn ka
Patience meri test na kar
Aa DJ aale gaana bajade
Jaun se baby keh rai ae
Bakhi puri kar dunga main
Koi kasar joh reh rai eh

O DJ waale mera gaana tu baja
Gaana bajayega toh aayega maza..

DJ waley babu mera gaana chala do
Gaana chala do.

snippet.title: Tum Se Tum Tak - Niyam
snippet.description:
Tum Se Tum Tak is a song built around the beauty of traditional Indian sounds, blending them with Niyam’s own modern musical identity.

We wanted to create the feeling of a qawwali gathering rather than just a conventional vocal section in the chorus. We layered hundreds of vocals, claps and harmonies, and later brought more people into the studio to add even more voices and energy to the section. The result is a rich, melancholic qawwali choir that feels almost larger than the song itself.

There’s something hypnotic about the hook, it pulls you in, makes you feel lost in the moment and lets the traditional instrumentation carry the emotion. snippet.title: Peng Dorjey Ko Damphu – Prakash Tamang Titung & Sumina Lo | Alisha Rai | Amir Dong | Bhimphedi Guys
snippet.description:
🎵 “Peng Dorjey Ko Damphu” is a special musical presentation inspired by the story of Peng Dorje and the traditional origins of the Damphu. Through this song and music video, Prakash Tamang Titung brings attention to the history, culture, love, and identity of the Tamang community.

The Damphu is not just a musical instrument for the Tamang people. Its sound carries memories of our ancestors, our traditional songs, dances, celebrations, and the stories passed from one generation to another. The name Peng Dorje holds a special place in the traditional story associated with the creation of this instrument.

As Prakash Tamang Titung shares, this project is much more than a song. It is the result of dedication, hard work, and a dream to present our own history, culture, and identity through music. It is also a small effort to protect the traditional art created by our ancestors and keep it alive for future generations.

This music video is especially meaningful for the Tamang community. It invites us to remember our roots, understand the value of our traditional instruments, and take pride in the culture that belongs to us. Let us come together to support this effort, share its message, and pass our traditions on to the younger generation.

Our Art, Our Culture, Our Identity.

❤️ सम्झना र आशीर्वाद (Samjhana Ra Aashirbad)

snippet.title: Arvind Akela Kallu New Song | पलंग के तुरी | Palang Ke Turi | Shilpi Raj | New Bhojpuri Song
snippet.description:
🎶 @SaregamaHumBhojpuri presents "Palang Ke Turi", a new Bhojpuri video song featuring the energetic voice of Arvind Akela Kallu and the screen presence of Mahi Shrivastava.

Credits:

Album Title: Palang Ke Turi
Song Title: Palang Ke Turi
Singer: Arvind Akela Kallu, Shilpi Raj
Lyricist: Gautam Rai Kala Nag
Music Director: Priyanshu Singh
Featuring: Mahi Shrivastava
Director & Choreographer: Raunak Raut
Assistant Choreographer: Vivek Mandal
DOP: Vazeer Art & Rahul Yadav
Editor: Rohan
DI: Sandeep Bajpai
BTS: Rahul Sharma
Makeup: Shibu
Art: Pawan

Lyrics:

M - घटतावे वेट , हई जवानी चकलेट तोहार सुना हुआ है 
हाल बा बेहाल , जान बीतल कई साल नाही मुना हुआ है 
F - के देखी सजल सिंगरवा कवन छुई बदन अंगूरी 
आय हाय रे मजबूरी , पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 
अरे खनकेला कंगना चूरी 
पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 

F - जवानी देता दरद हो , विदेश बाटे मरद हो 
M - रूपईया ला मुहवा मोडले बा , जवानी करोड़ो के छोड़ले बा
F - रहे सपनावा की सटीत सजानवा 
गाना बजाके भोजपुरी 
आय हाय रे मजबूरी , पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 
अरे खनकेला कंगना चूरी 
पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 

F - मन के मनाई कईसे, सजन के बोलाई कईसे
M - नज़र में केहू त धसल बा, लगाताटे दोसरे से फसल बा 
F - पता चली त ओकरा सीधे मारब करेजा में गोली
आय हाय रे मजबूरी , पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी 
अरे खनकेला कंगना चूरी 
पिया बिना पलंग के तुरी

snippet.title: Kaha Hola Ghar Bara - Karma Unplugged - Chapter 02
snippet.description:
KARMA UNPLUGGED
Chapter 02 - Kaha Hola Ghar Bara

In 2004, “Kaha Hola Ghar Bara” from our album SMS became a song that brought Karma Band closer to the hearts of many.

Years later, the song remains a part of our journey, our memories, and your love.
We bring it back, in its simplest form.

FILMED AT — THATHU BAHI BHAKTAPUR 

नेपाल मण्डलमा सयौंको संख्यामा रहेको वाहा, वही, कचावाहाहरुले हजारौं वर्ष देखि निरन्तर रूपमा बुद्ध धर्म र शिक्षा को संरक्षण गर्दै आएको छ। जस मध्ये बहीहरू बुद्ध धर्मको अध्ययन अध्यापन हुने बौद्ध विश्वविद्यालयको रूपमा रही आए‌को देखिन्छ भने वाहाहरुमा बुद्ध धर्म अभ्यास गर्दै आएको देखिन्छ। जस मध्ये भक्तपुर नगर‌मा हाल वडा नं. १ मा अवस्थित इताछें, न:पुखुसंगै अवस्थित एक महत्त्वपूर्ण वही हो - थथुवही । गोपाल राज वंशावली अनु‌सार ने.सं. २८९ मा विलुनायो र इलुनायो भनिने दुई व्यक्तिहरूले आफ्नो ऋण तिर्न सो पोखरी बनाएको पुष्टि भएबाट यो वही सो समय भन्दा पनि पौराणिक भएको मान्न सकिन्छ । यहाँ थथुवही र कुतथुवही नामक दुइ वटा बहीहरू जोडा आकारमा निर्माण भएको देखिन्छ। कलात्मक बास्तुकला एवं सृजनात्मक कलाकृतिहरुले भरिपूर्ण यस वहीमा सातौं शताब्दीको मुचलिन्ड बुद्धको मूर्ति तथा ने. सं. ६७६ को शाक्यसिंहको आशन हाल सम्म पनि सुरक्षित रहेको छ। यस वहीमा ५०० वर्ष अगाडिको शिलालेख समेत रहेको छ।

ने.सं. ७९४ मा बहछें ( चतुर्ब्रह्म महाबिहार )
का जयरत्न वज्राचार्यद्वारा जिर्णोद्धार गरिए पश्चात यस वहीलाई जयकिर्ति महाविहार पनि भन्ने गरिएको छ। ने.सं. ७८७ मा यस वहीमा सम्यक महादान पनि आयोजना गरिएको देखिन्छ । यस्ता थुप्रै ऐतिहासिक
अभिलेखहरुका कारण यस वही भक्तपुरको एक महत्वपूर्ण वही रहेको मान्न सकिन्छ । हाल सम्म पनि यस वहीमा थुप्रै खलका सर्वसंघहरु रहेका छन् भने जजमानको रूपमा जेष्ठवर्ण महाविहारका सर्व संघहरु हुन ।

Camera : Aabesh Muni Bajracharya
Production : Khagendra Paudel 
MUA : Sita Thapa
Edit / Color Grading by Surendra Man Singh
Vocal Harmonies : Kunjani Maharjan and Aakanshya Shrestha
Audio Mix & Mastering : Firoj Bajracharya (Jyoti Records) 

Heartfelt thanks to everyone who helped bring this chapter of Karma Unplugged to life. Special thanks to our crew — Lucky Maharjan, Susant Raj Thala, Safar Raj Thala, Samar Shrestha, Kabin Maharjan, and Safal Shrestha (Project Baja Nepal); Bekhal Dhimey Khala and team — Bibek Awal, Pratik Simachhwa, Christina Rajchal, Santosh Goshai, Raajak Khusu, Yashashree Prajapati, and Shree Krishna Khuju; Lalitpur Sound and Light Service and for location support, Dev Chandra Bajracharya, Dharma Chandra Shakya, and Ujay Bajracharya. 

This is KARMA UNPLUGGED — CHAPTER 02  "Kaha Hola Ghar Bara"
Series Concept : Ashish Parajuli

का जयरत्न वज्राचार्यद्वारा जिर्णोद्धार गरिए पश्चात यस वहीलाई जयकिर्ति महाविहार पनि भन्ने गरिएको छ। ने.सं. ७८७ मा यस वहीमा सम्यक महादान पनि आयोजना गरिएको देखिन्छ । यस्ता थुप्रै ऐतिहासिक
अभिलेखहरुका कारण यस वही भक्तपुरको एक महत्वपूर्ण वही रहेको मान्न सकिन्छ । हाल सम्म पनि यस वहीमा थुप्रै खलका सर्वसंघहरु रहेका छन् भने जजमानको रूपमा जेष्ठवर्ण महाविहारका सर्व संघहरु हुन ।

Performed by the dynamic vocal duo Prashant Siwakoti and Rachana Rimal, with lyrics and composed by Prashant Siwakoti, this track highlights deep romantic emotions, beautiful expressions of love, and top-tier cinematic production under Music Nepal.

Song Title: Mayalee (मयाली)

Movie: Sarathi

Featuring: Giri Bishwakarma & Gayatri Joshi

Singers: Prashant Siwakoti & Rachana Rimal

Lyricists & Music Composer: Prashant Siwakoti

Music Arranger: Bisham Acharya

Studio: Hamro Studio

Mixing & Mastering: Samik (Sound Co. Mumbai)

Live Instruments: Flute (Ratna BK), Sarangi (Manish Gandarva), Madal (Poshan Magar), Guitar (Purushkar Khadka)

Choreographer: Kabiraj Gahatraj (Ass. Choreographer: Dawa Bal Lama)

snippet.description:
🙏 सुन्दरम् | Sundaram — भगवान श्री हरि विष्णु को समर्पित एक दिव्य और भावपूर्ण भजन।

सुन्दरम् (Sundaram) एक सुंदर हिंदी भक्ति गीत है, जो भगवान श्री विष्णु, श्री कृष्ण और श्री हरि नारायण की दिव्य महिमा, करुणा और अनंत सुंदरता को समर्पित है।

यदि आप Vishnu Bhajan, Krishna Bhajan, Narayan Bhajan, Guruwar Special Bhajan, Shri Hari Bhajan या शांत और मन को सुकून देने वाले भक्ति गीत सुनना पसंद करते हैं, तो यह भजन आपके लिए है।

🌸 ** Sundaram | सुन्दरम् — श्री हरि की अनंत महिमा** 🌸

इस भक्तिमय संगीत और दिव्य दृश्यों के माध्यम से भगवान विष्णु के विभिन्न स्वरूपों, उनकी करुणा, भक्त प्रह्लाद की रक्षा, गजेन्द्र मोक्ष और श्री सत्यनारायण की आराधना की झलक प्रस्तुत की गई है।

यह भजन गुरुवार की पूजा, भगवान विष्णु की आराधना, सुबह की प्रार्थना, ध्यान, भक्ति और आध्यात्मिक शांति के क्षणों के लिए उपयुक्त है।

✨ **About the Song**

🎵 Song: सुन्दरम् (Sundaram)
🎤 Artist / Presented by: JHD Tunes
🎶 Genre: Hindi Devotional Bhajan | Vishnu Bhakti | Spiritual Music
🙏 Dedicated to: Lord Vishnu, Shri Hari Narayan
📺 Music Video: JHD Tunes

🌼 **इस भजन से जुड़े भक्ति विषय**

• भगवान विष्णु भजन — Vishnu Bhajan

snippet.title: Dhaley Dhaley - Bluesss x iMAGE x Karma Lala (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
“Dhaley Dhaley” is a collaboration between Bluesss, Image, and Karmalala, unfolding as the first chapter of a story that is intentionally left untold. The music video captures a journey towards the BLUESKI Experience, hosted by Abom, leaving subtle hints of a bigger picture waiting to be discovered. But this is only half the story. The journey continues in the next song in the the opening track of the album "BLUESKI" , where the other half of the narrative begins to unfold.


Stargirls - Ranya, Unnati, Ming Doma Sherpa, Nisha & Ruby Panta
Starboys - Abom , Artha Bhattarai
